criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: OSM way 1324500897 is explicitly tagged building=dormitory and name=3rd and West; the official Purdue housing article and project source identify the Third Street/McCormick Road 3rd and West community.
The 14-node outline is faithfully implemented; independent probe found a maximum node-to-structural-shell error of 0.00005962 m.
No independent surveyed or official footprint was found, so this does not validate the OSM polygon itself.
criteria.deduction: Footprint identity is plausible and source-backed but relies on OSM as the sole geometric outline.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: The OSM ring was independently transformed using the project’s stated compatibility formula; model vertex comparison and bounds agree.

The footprint area is 5553.9 m² with extents approximately 108.6 by 91.5 m. Official project material reports 325,000 sq ft gross floor area; five times the footprint is approximately 298910 sq ft, about 8% lower, a plausible but not conclusive scale cross-check.
Official sources confirm the building is at Third Street and McCormick Road.
criteria.deduction: No independent current map/survey registration or orientation measurement; the OSM coordinates are both the placement input and the comparison source.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue University Residences and Purdue Research Foundation project pages state five stories; the saved Purdue photo visibly supports a flat parapeted roof silhouette.
The modeled 18.0 m eave, 0.9 m parapet and 18.9 m total height are clearly labeled estimates, not measurements.
criteria.deduction: No published elevation or height measurement; exact roof equipment/profile and story heights remain unverified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: The official Purdue Research Foundation photo shows light facade fields, dark repeated windows, brick end masses and a courtyard-facing residential elevation.
SCB’s project description supports two courtyards, a transparent amenity ground floor, and patterned brick/glazing; the model represents broad courtyard wings, repeated windows and brick accents.
criteria.deduction: The model is a coarse proxy: bay spacing, glazing proportions, entrance/plaza placement and distinctive corner study volumes are not measured and are only partly expressed.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender reopen found the expected scene and collection with 19 mesh objects.
A fresh empty Blender file linked the named collection and loaded all 19 meshes.
No external images, fonts or linked libraries are required; the builder, source snapshots, preview, validation records and uncertainties are saved.

findings: PASS: this is a source-informed upgrade from an undifferentiated block; official sources confirm identity, five stories and two-courtyard design.
Limit: the OSM outline was used as the build geometry, so node-level agreement is an implementation check, not independent footprint validation.
Limit: vertical dimensions, roof equipment, facade bay sizes and exact entrance placement remain estimates or unverified.
